d.ko: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT
d.en: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT
d.zh:
看着成群的小小重击者扑向行星，一路开采，直到将其击碎。再把矿石投入虚空，让蜂群变得更庞大、更迅捷。
重击。击碎。再来。
